title: Internal resistance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates internal resistance r = 0.5 Ω using E = U + Ir or equivalent.

title: Parallel equivalent resistance
description: Important: Correctly computes equivalent resistance of parallel combination (2.0 Ω).

title: Terminal voltage with parallel load
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U₁ = 3.6 V using Ohm's law with new circuit parameters.

title: Series circuit current
description: Important: Correctly determines total current (0.5 A) with series resistor R₂ added.

title: Joule heat calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes Q = 67.5 J using P = I²R with proper time conversion.

title: Time unit conversion
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert 1 minute to 60 seconds in Joule heat formula.

title: Sign error in voltage equation
description: Pitfall: Uses E = U - Ir instead of E = U + Ir for internal resistance calculation.

title: Parallel/series confusion
description: Pitfall: Treats parallel resistor as series in part (2) or vice versa in part (3).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis for all calculations to verify dimensional consistency.
